caseName: Standard Oil Co. v. Florida ex rel. Shevin
caseNameFull: Standard Oil Company of California v. Florida ex rel. Shevin, Attorney General of Florida

opinions.text: Application for stay of mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit pending timely filing and disposition of a petition for writ of cer-tiorari, presented to Mr. Justice Powell, and by him referred to the Court, denied.
